LA_LUST.title: LDEQ Leaking Underground Storage Tanks (open cases)
LA_LUST.coverage_note: Open LUST cases in TEMPO only; closed releases are not in this layer (historical releases come from EPA UST Finder).

LA_UST.title: LDEQ Registered Underground Storage Tank Facilities
LA_UST.coverage_note: Currently registered facilities; closed/removed tank facilities come from EPA UST Finder. 0.25 mi used for ASTM 'property and adjoining' (EDR convention).

LA_RECAP_GW.title: LDEQ RECAP Groundwater Classification Sites (UST)
LA_RECAP_GW.coverage_note: Motor Fuel Trust Fund UST sites assigned a RECAP groundwater class; corroborates a release. LDEQ publishes no date for this layer.

LA_UST_MW_2005.title: LDEQ Monitoring Wells at Motor Fuel UST Sites (2005)
LA_UST_MW_2005.coverage_note: Groundwater monitoring wells at motor fuel UST sites, 2005 snapshot; wells are collapsed to one record per AI. A monitoring well indicates a release investigation. 0.25 mi used for ASTM 'property and adjoining' (EDR convention).

LA_STAGE2_2009.title: LDEQ Stage II Vapor Recovery Facilities (2009)
LA_STAGE2_2009.coverage_note: 2009 gasoline station list. Coverage limited to the Baton Rouge ozone nonattainment parishes (East Baton Rouge, Ascension, Livingston, West Baton Rouge, Iberville, Pointe Coupee). 0.25 mi used for ASTM 'property and adjoining' (EDR convention).

LA_TITLE_V.title: LDEQ Title V Air Permitted Facilities
LA_TITLE_V.coverage_note: 0.25 mi used for ASTM 'property and adjoining' (EDR convention).

LA_LPDES.title: LDEQ Active Water Facilities (LPDES permits)
LA_LPDES.coverage_note: Active LPDES permits and general permit coverages only (e.g., LAG75 vehicle wash water), which EPA NPDES data often omits. Expired and inactive permits are not published by LDEQ in this layer. Permits collapsed to one record per AI. Searched to 1/8 mi (subject and adjoining properties).

LA_DEBRIS.title: LDEQ Emergency Debris Sites
LA_DEBRIS.coverage_note: Storm debris staging, reduction, burning, and disposal sites, active and closed (ACTIVE field). Each record lists the activities LDEQ approved; burning, burial, disposal, HHW and orphan-drum staging are marked as flagged activities. 0.25 mi used for ASTM 'property and adjoining' (EDR convention).

LA_VRP.title: LDEQ Voluntary Remediation Program Sites
LA_VRP.astm_class: State/tribal voluntary cleanup sites; sites with institutional controls also serve the State/tribal IC/EC registry (subject property)
LA_VRP.coverage_note: Locations reconciled across TEMPO, the VRP list, and Census geocoding; see la_vrp_reconcile report. Applications collapsed to one site per AI; all statuses retained.
